apps.name: Chat
apps.values: Speed stays the same on every computer
apps.line: A full chat app. Its developer asked Cale for a minimum speed, not a model size.

apps.name: Quick Notes
apps.line: Ghost-text suggestions while you type. Its developer asked for a first word in about a second.

apps.name: Private Doc Reader
apps.line: Your private documents never leave this computer. Its developer always asks for the full size, and tells you the time up front.

apps.name: Background Sorter
apps.line: Sorts a folder of messy notes into a tidy table while you work. Its developer asked for low power and low memory.

apps.name: Meeting Recap
apps.line: A Node.js app. Same Cale, no Python anywhere in it.

apps.name: Rewrite
apps.values: Words appear faster than you read
apps.line: Paste a sentence, pick a tone, and the new version streams in. Its developer asked for reading speed, not a model size.
